content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Family Court Patiala Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://patiala.dcourts.gov.in/. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification before 4:00 PM on 14.09.2026. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 14-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Family Court Patiala Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the Family Court Patiala Recruitment 2026 is 14th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Family Counsellor and Child Counsellor posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies, with 3 for Family Counsellor and 1 for Child Counsellor.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum age requirement for these posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement for both Family Counsellor and Child Counsellor posts is 35 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Family Court Patiala recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Graduate degree in Social Science/Sociology, Psychology, Clinical Psychiatry, or Law, with at least 2 years of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for these positions?
faq.answer: The application process for the Family Court Patiala Recruitment 2026 is offline.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the counsellor posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves empanelment based on applications and testimonials, followed by an interaction with the candidates.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary or honorarium for the selected candidates?
faq.answer: The salary or honorarium will be as determined by the State Government.

faq.question: Q9. Where should the application form be submitted?
faq.answer: The completed application form should be submitted to the office of the District & Sessions Judge, Patiala.

faq.question: Q10. When is the interaction with the candidates scheduled?
faq.answer: The interaction with the candidates is scheduled to take place on 22nd September 2026.
